create.name: Mukhāravinda (Jatipura)
create.location: Jatipura, on the Govardhana parikramā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: The «lotus face» of Giriraja Govardhana, worshipped with milk abhiṣeka; Jatipura is where Mādhavendra Purī's Gopāla (Śrī Nāthajī) was served.

create.name: Candra-sarovara (Paraśaulī)
create.about: Here Kṛṣṇa's rāsa-līlā lasted a whole night of Brahmā in the light of the full moon. Vallabhācārya's sitting-place and the kuṭī and samādhi of Sūradāsa are here.

create.name: Paiṭhā-grāma
create.about: A village of the Govardhana area connected with the lifting of Govardhana.

create.name: Ānyora
create.about: Where the Annakūṭa offering to Giriraja was made; nearby is the place where Śrī Nāthajī (Gopāla) appeared.

create.name: Govinda-kuṇḍa
create.about: Formed by the waters of the abhiṣeka with which Indra and Surabhi bathed Kṛṣṇa after the lifting of Govardhana, naming Him Govinda. Mādhavendra Purī found Gopāla near here.

create.name: Puñchari
create.aka: Punchari, Pūñchari kā Lauṭhā, Apsarā-kuṇḍa, Navala-kuṇḍa
create.location: At the southern tail of Govardhana (coordinates approximate)
create.about: The «tail» of Giriraja; Apsarā-kuṇḍa and Navala-kuṇḍa are here, and the cave where Rāghava Paṇḍita did bhajana.

create.name: Surabhi-kuṇḍa
create.about: Where the cow Surabhi bathed Kṛṣṇa with her milk after the lifting of Govardhana.

create.name: Airāvata-kuṇḍa
create.about: Made by Indra's elephant Airāvata when Indra came to beg forgiveness and bathe Kṛṣṇa.

create.name: Ādi-badrī
create.about: To spare the Vrajavāsīs the long journey, Kṛṣṇa manifested Badarikāśrama here, with Nara-Nārāyaṇa-parvata.

create.name: Ādi-kedāranātha
create.about: Kṛṣṇa manifested Kedāranātha Mahādeva on a hill here so that Nanda and Yaśodā could have his darśana without going to the Himālayas.
create.source: Śrī Vraja-maṇḍala Parikramā (after the Govardhana parikramā)

create.name: Kāmeśvara Mahādeva
create.about: Śiva as Kāmeśvara, the protector of Kāmyavana.

create.name: Vimala-kuṇḍa
create.about: The chief kuṇḍa of Kāmyavana; bathing here is said to give the result of bathing in all the tīrthas.

create.name: Caraṇa-pahāḍī (Kāmyavana)
create.about: When Kṛṣṇa played His flute here the rocks melted, and the prints of His feet remained in the stone.

create.name: Bhojana-thālī
create.about: On a rock here Kṛṣṇa and the cowherd boys ate their lunch; the marks of their plates (thālī) and cups are in the stone.

create.name: Dharma-kuṇḍa
create.about: Yudhiṣṭhira (Dharmarāja) answered the questions of Yamarāja (as a yakṣa) at this kuṇḍa.
